$comment: Shared behavioral contract for every trackstack-calendar-client implementation (this repo's Node /calendar-client subpath, and the trackstack-calendar-client PyPI package). Each implementation's own test suite loads this file and asserts identical request-building behavior against it, so the two can't silently drift the way the auth PAT-fallback logic once did before either had a shared contract fixture. Keep this file byte-identical across both repos -- if it ever needs to change, update it in both places in the same commit/session.
$behavior: Given pushInput (no kind) with tracker='finance': POST expectedUrl with body == expectedRequestBody (tracker injected server-side-of-the-client, kind omitted from the body entirely since pushInput has no kind field), Authorization header == expectedAuthorizationHeader. A response with successResponseStatus resolves true.
Given pushInputWithKind (kind: 'forecast'): the sent body must equal expectedRequestBodyWithKind -- kind is passed through verbatim, everything else unchanged.
color is always present in the sent body (unlike kind, which is omitted entirely when absent) -- null when pushInput/pushInputWithKind doesn't set one, passed through verbatim otherwise.
link behaves exactly like color: always present, null when unset, passed through verbatim otherwise.
A non-2xx response (e.g. notFoundResponseStatus) resolves false, never throws or rejects.
A network/connection failure resolves false, never throws or rejects -- the caller's own request must never fail because a calendar push failed.
